extraction_note: Curated walking-tour guide. Chunked at the natural per-chapter level: the 9 neighborhood chapters, each = NEIGHBORHOOD WALK (numbered POI route with descriptions + addresses/transit) + IN DEPTH (deep dive on one landmark) + DISTINCTLY NEW YORK (cultural essay) + BEST OF (themed picks). Extracted in column-flow (non -layout) mode for clean two-column reading. Excluded as non-tour-landmark: front matter (Introduction, Visiting New York, Using This Guide), the WHIRLWIND TOURS itineraries (New York in a Day/Weekend/For Fun/With Kids — OCR-mangled and redundant with the neighborhood chapters), and back matter (Travel Essentials, Hotels, Index, Credits).

chunks.summary: Lower Manhattan walk: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island, Battery Park, National Museum of the American Indian, Fraunces Tavern, Federal Hall, Wall Street, World Trade Center/9-11 Memorial; IN DEPTH Statue of Liberty; A City of Immigrants; Downtown Shopping.

The Villages walk: Union Square, Greenwich Village, Washington Square Park, NYU, the West Village and East Village; IN DEPTH Washington Square Park; Modern Greats essay; Village shopping & nightlife picks.

Midtown South walk: Flatiron/Madison Square, Chelsea & the High Line, Hotel Chelsea, Gramercy/Pete's Tavern, the Morgan Library; IN DEPTH The Library Lions / Morgan; fashion district essay; Midtown South dining picks.
Midtown North walk: Rockefeller Center, Times Square & theater district, Fifth Avenue, MoMA, St. Patrick's; IN DEPTH the Post-Impressionist era at MoMA; skyscraper-canyon essay; Midtown North picks.

Upper East Side walk: Museum Mile — Metropolitan Museum of Art, Guggenheim, Frick, Jewish Museum — plus the Armory and Madison Avenue; IN DEPTH Ancient Egypt at the Met & the Armory; uptown shopping picks.
Central Park walk: Loeb Boathouse, the Mall, Bethesda Terrace, Shakespeare Garden, the Ramble, Lasker Pool; Olmsted & Vaux design history; The City's Star essay; outdoor-activities picks.
Upper West Side walk: Lincoln Center, the Dakota, Central Park West, American Museum of Natural History; IN DEPTH Milstein Hall of Ocean Life; neighborhood-history essay; Upper West Side picks.

The Heights & Harlem walk: Cathedral of St. John the Divine, Columbia, Riverside Park, Harlem, Abyssinian Baptist Church, the Met Cloisters; IN DEPTH Early Medieval Masterpieces at the Cloisters; Harlem Renaissance essay.

Brooklyn walk: Brooklyn Bridge & DUMBO, Brooklyn Heights promenade, Trinity Church, Brooklyn Museum, Botanic Garden, Prospect Park & Park Slope, the Brooklyn Public Library; IN DEPTH African Galleries; Brooklyn dining & culture picks.
